c007_00070_dl.text_frei: What a funny watch, she remarked.

c007_00071_s.text_frei: It tells the day of the month and doesn't tell what a crock it is.

c007_00073_dl.text_frei: Why should it? muttered the Hatter.

c007_00074_dl.text_frei: Does your watch tell you what year it is?

c007_00076_dl.text_frei: Of course not, Alice replied very readily. But that's because it stays the same year for such a long time together.

c007_00078_dl.text_frei: Which is just the case with mine, said the Hatter.
c007_00078_dl.text_ziel: Which is just the case with mine, said the Hatter.

c007_00081_s.text_frei: The Hatter's remark seemed to have no sort of meaning in it, and yet it was certainly English.
c007_00081_s.text_ziel: The Hatter's remark seemed to have no sort of meaning in it, and yet it was certainly English.

c007_00082_dl.text_frei: I don't quite understand you, she said as politely as she could.

c007_00086_s.text_frei: The Dormouse shook its head impatiently and said without opening its eyes, Of course, of course, just what I was going to remark myself.

c007_00088_dl.text_frei: Have you guessed the riddle yet? The Hatter said, turning to Alice again.

c007_00090_dl.text_frei: No, I give it up, Alice replied. What's the answer?

c007_00092_dl.text_frei: I haven't the slightest idea, said the Hatter.
c007_00092_dl.text_ziel: I haven't the slightest idea, said the Hatter.

c007_00094_dl.text_frei: Nor I, said the March Hare.
c007_00094_dl.text_ziel: Nor I, said the March Hare.

c007_00097_dl.text_frei: I think you might do something better with the time, she said. Then waste it in asking riddles that have no answers.
c007_00097_dl.text_ziel: I think you might do something better with the time, she said. Then waste it in asking riddles that have no answers.

c007_00099_dl.text_frei: If you knew time as well as I do, said the Hatter, you wouldn't talk about wasting it.
c007_00099_dl.text_ziel: If you knew time as well as I do, said the Hatter, you wouldn't talk about wasting it.

c007_00102_dl.text_frei: I don't know what you mean, said Alice.
c007_00102_dl.text_ziel: I don't know what you mean, said Alice.

c007_00104_dl.text_frei: Of course you don't, the Hatter said, tossing his head contemptuously.
c007_00104_dl.text_ziel: Of course you don't, the Hatter said, tossing his head contemptuously.

c007_00105_s.text_frei: I dare say you never even spoke to time.
c007_00105_s.text_ziel: I dare say you never even spoke to time.

c007_00107_dl.text_frei: Perhaps not, Alice cautiously replied. But I know I have to beat time when I learn music.
c007_00107_dl.text_ziel: Perhaps not, Alice cautiously replied. But I know I have to beat time when I learn music.

c007_00109_dl.text_frei: Ah, that accounts for it, said the Hatter.
c007_00109_dl.text_ziel: Ah, that accounts for it, said the Hatter.

c007_00111_s.text_frei: Now, if you only kept on good terms with him, he'd do almost anything you liked with the clock.
c007_00111_s.text_ziel: Now, if you only kept on good terms with him, he'd do almost anything you liked with the clock.

c007_00112_s.text_frei: For instance, suppose it were nine o'clock in the morning. Just time to begin lessons. You'd only have to whisper a hint to time and round goes the clock in a twinkling.

c007_00113_s.text_frei: Half past one. Time for dinner.

c007_00114_s.text_frei: I only wish it was, the March Hare said to itself in a whisper.

c007_00116_dl.text_frei: That would be grand, certainly, said Alice thoughtfully. But then I shouldn't be hungry for it, you know.

c007_00120_dl.text_frei: Is that the way you manage? Alice asked.

c007_00122_s.text_frei: The Hatter shook his head mournfully.
c007_00122_s.text_ziel: The Hatter shook his head mournfully.

c007_00124_s.text_frei: We quarrelled last March, just before he went mad, you know. Pointing with his teaspoon at the March Hare. It was at the great concert given by the Queen of Hearts, and I had to sing.

c007_00125_qt.text_frei: Twinkle, twinkle, little bat, how I wonder what you're at!

c007_00128_dl.text_frei: I've heard something like it, said Alice.

c007_00130_s.text_frei: It goes on, you know, the Hatter continued, in this way.

c007_00131_qt.text_frei: Up above the world you fly, like a tea tray in the sky. Twinkle, twinkle.

c007_00141_s.text_frei: A bright idea came into Alice's head.

c007_00152_dl.text_frei: Suppose we change the subject. The March Hare interrupted, yawning.

c007_00154_s.text_frei: I vote the young lady tells us a story.
